data.name: Misaki
data.description:
Misaki serves as the "normal girl" trope. She is a relatively laidback person who is unable to fight against the flow of a conversation or series of events even if she attempts to do so, the most prominent example being the series of events leading up to her joining the band in the first place. Her initial personality displayed that she didn't want any trouble, never wanted it at any point in time, and would have preferred a quieter life if possible.

Despite the exasperation she lives with by being the closest thing to a normal person the band has, Misaki is a diligent individual capable of getting things done when she wants to get them done. 

Even with a hardworking nature, exemplified by her accomplishments working with her band, she tends to debase her achievements and claim that anyone else could do what she does. 
Misaki is the president in student council.
